scope: Seller fees on US Mercari listings created or updated since January 6, 2025; the buyer-paid Buyer Protection fee is shown for context. Legacy pre-2025 listings are described in notes.
structure: For listings created or updated on or after January 6, 2025, the seller pays a flat 10% selling fee on the combined item price plus buyer-paid shipping; no separate payment-processing fee is charged to either side. The buyer pays a 3.6% Buyer Protection fee on the same base (item price + buyer-paid shipping), shown in the checkout total and not deducted from the seller. Legacy listings created before January 6, 2025 and never updated carry the old structure instead: no seller fee, but the buyer pays a 10% service fee and a payment-processing fee of $0.50 + 2.9% of the transaction price (item + shipping + service fee + sales tax). Payouts: ACH direct deposit is free (once per day; $2 for each failed request); Instant Pay costs a flat $3 per cash-out (once per day, up to $600/month). Rounding is not published.
quotes: Listing an item is always free on Mercari. Fees are charged when an item sells or when a service is used.
Effective January 6, 2025, a 10% selling fee will apply to item price and buyer-paid shipping for new and updated listings.
A 10% selling fee of the combined amount of item price and buyer-paid shipping will be charged to the seller.
Existing listings created before January 6, 2025 A selling fee will not be applied until the listing is updated.
Effective January 6, 2025, Mercari will no longer charge buyers a payment processing fee at the time of purchase on new or updated listings.
Until the listing is updated, a Payment Processing Fee of $0.50 plus 2.9% of the transaction price (includes the item price, shipping, service fee and sales tax) will be charged to the buyer.
Starting January 6, 2025, a Buyer Protection fee of 3.6% will apply to the item price and buyer-paid shipping for new and updated listings.
A 10% buyer fee will apply to the buyer until the listing is updated.
Effective January 6, 2025 at 2:00 PM PT, there is no longer a $2 non-refundable fee per cash-out.
There is $2 non-refundable fee for each failed direct deposit request.
You can use Instant Pay for up to $600 per month, once per day on eligible debit cards. There is a $3 flat fee per cash-out.
$3 fee For each completed Instant Pay transfer.

If a seller has frequent cancelations, Mercari may charge a cancelation fee of 5% of the item price (maximum of $25) to cover the cost of any transaction fees, operational and/or shipping label costs we incur.
Sellers will pay a flat 10% selling fee on the completed item price and buyer-paid shipping
No additional payment processing fee for either buyers or sellers
Payment processing fees (2.9% + $0.50) apply to items sold with the old fee structure.
We’re removing the ACH direct deposit fee for successful withdrawal transactions. Limit to one ACH direct deposit per day.
excluded: Mercari Authenticate listing fee ($5) and Certificate of Authenticity ($10)
Prepaid shipping label rates (USPS/UPS/FedEx tables; USPS rates updated May 7, 2026) and underpaid-label / wrong-packaging surcharges
Legal document processing fee ($25/hour, paid by agencies)
notes: Timeline (official): March 2024 — seller fees removed and a buyer service fee introduced ('When we initially introduced our current fee structure in March ... sellers got to keep 100% of their sales proceeds'); January 6, 2025 — 10% selling fee reinstated, 3.6% Buyer Protection fee introduced, payment-processing fee dropped for new/updated listings, $2 ACH cash-out fee removed at 2:00 PM PT; January 6–12, 2025 — transition week with no 10% fee on old-structure listings; May 7, 2026 — prepaid USPS label rates changed for the fuel surcharge (fee page 'Updated 05/07/2026'). No 2026 change to the 10% / 3.6% structure appears on official pages.
Conflict: several third-party pages date the reinstated 10% fee to 'January 6, 2026' — UNVERIFIED and contradicted by Mercari's own pages, which say January 6, 2025.

Calculator ambiguity: the fee base is 'item price + buyer-paid shipping'. When the seller offers free shipping there is no buyer-paid shipping in the base, and the label cost comes out of the seller's proceeds (label prices from the rate table); when the buyer pays shipping via a Mercari label, the fee is 10% of item + shipping even though the shipping money passes through to the carrier.

Legacy structure applies only to listings created before Jan 6, 2025 that were never updated; Mercari said existing listings would be 'updated automatically within a week', so it should be rare in 2026.

Instant Pay details ($3 flat, $600/month, once per day, up to 30 minutes) come from the fee page; the dedicated Instant Pay how-to article (article 93) is JavaScript-rendered and returned an empty body to HTTP fetchers.
summary: Mercari takes a 10% selling fee on the item price plus buyer-paid shipping, with no separate payment processing fee, for listings created or updated since January 6, 2025. The buyer pays a 3.6% Buyer Protection fee on top. Instant Pay costs $3 per cash-out; direct deposit is free.
